e.title: Robust Loss Reserving (UNSW)
e.summary: 多元稳健损失准备金异常值检测论文代码（Avanzi/Lavender/Taylor/Wong）：稳健二元链梯
e.body: reserving-robust 是论文《Detection and treatment of outliers in multivariate robust loss reserving》（Avanzi, Lavender, Taylor, Wong）的 R 代码：对多元稳健损失准备金做异常值检测与处理——应用稳健二元链梯技术（Verdonk & Van Wouwe 2011）于不同异常值检测与调整方法。异常值是准备金数据的实际痛点（一次大案就能扭曲链梯因子）。UNSW agi-lab 系列。关联 [[chainladder]]、[[reserving-impact-factors]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reserving-ensemble]]。

e.summary_en: Paper code for outlier detection and treatment in multivariate robust loss reserving (Avanzi/Lavender/Taylor/Wong): robust bivariate chain-ladder
e.summary_hk: 多元穩健損失準備金異常值檢測論文代碼（Avanzi/Lavender/Taylor/Wong）：穩健二元鏈梯
e.body_en: reserving-robust is the R code of the paper 'Detection and treatment of outliers in multivariate robust loss reserving' (Avanzi, Lavender, Taylor, Wong): outlier detection and treatment for multivariate robust loss reserving — applying the robust bivariate chain-ladder technique (Verdonk & Van Wouwe 2011) across different outlier detection and adjustment methods. Outliers are a real pain point in reserving data (one large claim can distort chain-ladder factors). From the UNSW agi-lab series. Related: [[chainladder]], [[reserving-impact-factors]], [[actuarial-pricing]], [[reserving-ensemble]].
e.body_hk: reserving-robust 是論文《Detection and treatment of outliers in multivariate robust loss reserving》（Avanzi, Lavender, Taylor, Wong）的 R 代碼：對多元穩健損失準備金做異常值檢測與處理——應用穩健二元鏈梯技術（Verdonk & Van Wouwe 2011）於不同異常值檢測與調整方法。異常值是準備金數據的實際痛點（一次大案就能扭曲鏈梯因子）。UNSW agi-lab 系列。關聯 [[chainladder]]、[[reserving-impact-factors]]、[[actuarial-pricing]]、[[reserving-ensemble]]。
